schema_note: Full enriched card for retrodiction R027. Merges: original candidate card, parameter/overfitting audit, four-member adversarial skeptic panel, the repair-agent repair, and the fertility-judge scores. card.one_sentence_claim: A single finite operator identity — the route-mismatch commutator RM(E,T;rho)=d(E T rho, T E rho) between a coarse-graining/packaging map E and a micro time-stepper T — is the common structural template whose leading correction term instantiates exactly as the LES subgrid stress tau_sgs (filtering vs Burgers flux), the Buchert/Jensen backreaction term (averaging vs nonlinear FLRW evolution), and quantum measurement-evolution incompatibility (dephasing vs unitary), with a Lean-certified sufficient condition (factorization-through-the-macro-layer implies commutation, RM=0) and a falsifiable null (linear or record-diagonal dynamics give RM=0).
card.target_known_fact: Three independently established facts, each recovered (not derived) and reorganized under one commutator: (a) spatial filtering of the Burgers/Navier-Stokes nonlinear flux produces the subgrid stress tau_sgs = overline(u^2)-(overline u)^2 (Leonard 1974, Germano 1992); (b) nonlinear evolution does not commute with spatial averaging of an inhomogeneous universe, the Buchert backreaction / Jensen-inequality effect; (c) unitary evolution does not commute with dephasing/record-basis closure unless H is diagonal in the record basis (measurement-evolution incompatibility / contextuality).
card.scientific_domain: Cross-domain within physics: turbulence/fluid model reduction (LES) + relativistic cosmology (backreaction) + quantum measurement theory (contextuality/decoherence), unified at the level of finite operator algebra (closure calculus), not at the level of physical content.

required_definitions: Closure/packaging endomap E = U_f o Q_f on Delta(Z) (lift composed with deterministic pushforward), with idempotence in the section regime Q_f U_f = id; for LES the lens-only commutator (no canonical U) Q o T - T o Q.

FactorsThrough predicate (Lean): micro dynamics descends along the lens and preserves the completion's fibers.

required_lemmas.statement: Factorization through the macro layer implies commutation, hence RM=0 (sufficient direction only).

Filtering the 1D Burgers nonlinear flux yields the exact identity overline(partial_x(u^2/2)) - partial_x((bar u)^2/2) = (1/2) partial_x tau_sgs with tau_sgs = overline(u^2)-(bar u)^2; tau_sgs identically 0 for linear dynamics.

main_steps: State the template once: fix finite Z, lens Q_f, completion U_f (or lens-only when no canonical U exists), stepper T; define E and RM_d(E,T;rho)=d(E T rho, T E rho).

Prove (cite) the certified direction: FactorsThrough => RM=0 (commutes_of_factorsThrough); contrapositive frames generic RM>0 as the default regime. State the matching null gate: RM=0 in the linear/record-diagonal control.

Instantiate three times, each with the IMPORTED domain dynamics: (i) T=Burgers RK4 stepper, Q=Gaussian filter -> RM grows with sigma and the exact residual is tau_sgs; (ii) T=nonlinear ODE flow, Q=ensemble average -> RM grows with heterogeneity s (Jensen); (iii) T=unitary conjugation, E=dephasing -> RM=0 for diagonal H, 0.350099 generic.

Tabulate the null-vs-active separation per domain from the existing deterministic suites (sigma sweep, s sweep, lambda/H sweep) and exhibit the shared shape: RM=0 on the control axis, monotone increase off it.

Make the unification claim PRECISELY at the level it is licensed: the three correction terms are the leading residual of one commutator FUNCTIONAL FORM with a shared vanishing criterion; explicitly flag that the physical content (cascade vs acceleration vs Born statistics) is NOT unified and the dynamics are imported.
Optionally attempt the genuine-unification lemma (common ambient algebra/operad) and report it as the open hard step that would upgrade the analogy to a theorem.
data_comparison_steps: LES: reproduce tau_sgs(sigma) and RM(sigma) on viscous Burgers (sigma in {0, 0.049, 0.098, 0.196, 0.393}); check sigma=0 control RM~0 and that max tau_l2 scales with sigma (0 -> 0.175) matching Table tab:les-subgrid-term; cross-check against a textbook Leonard-stress computation that the SBT tau_sgs equals the standard subgrid stress.

Backreaction: reproduce the Jensen toy y'=y^2 mismatch vs heterogeneity s (s=0 control ~3.89e-16); compare the sign and growth qualitatively to the published Buchert kinematical backreaction Q_D (sign convention, dependence on variance of expansion) — note this is a qualitative analogy, not a GR computation.

Quantum: reproduce RM(Delta,U_tau) for random vs diagonal H (max 0.350099 vs 0; seed 0) and confirm RM=0 exactly on the joint fixed-point set; cross-check the diagonal-H vanishing against the elementary fact [Delta, U]=0 iff H is block-diagonal in the record basis.

Cross-domain: assemble the three null-vs-active tables into one figure showing the shared 'RM=0 on control, monotone off control' signature; this is the demonstration artifact, NOT a fit to any single dataset.
proof_route.minimum_viable_result: A single short note + reproducible script that (a) states the route-mismatch template and the certified factorization=>commutation lemma once, (b) re-derives the three correction terms (tau_sgs exact identity; Jensen gap; [Delta,U] defect) as RM-residuals of the same functional, and (c) tabulates the shared null-vs-active separation across the existing deterministic suites — i.e. a rigorous statement of STRUCTURAL parallelism with a common vanishing criterion, honestly labeled as reorganization of three known results, not new physics.
proof_route.stronger_result: A genuine unification theorem: construct one ambient object (noncommutative algebra / monoidal category / operad of coarse-grainings) in which filtering, spatial averaging and dephasing are instances of ONE morphism class and Burgers flux, FLRW dust averaging and unitary conjugation are instances of ONE endofunctor class, such that the LES subgrid stress, the Buchert Q-term and the [Delta,U] commutator are literally the SAME natural-transformation defect — upgrading 'same kind of commutator' from analogy to a single construction, with the three known terms recovered as corollaries.
estimated_bottlenecks: The unification is at the level of 'a commutator of a projection with a flow'; the SAME-object claim (stronger result) requires a common ambient algebra that the papers do not build and that may not exist non-trivially across these three very different dynamics.

Disclaimer wall: SBT explicitly disclaims deriving Navier-Stokes, GR backreaction, and the Born rule, so the claim can never be 'we derive these terms' — only 'we recover/reorganize them'. Any wording stronger than reorganization crosses a frozen disclaimer.

Only the trivial sufficient direction (factorization => RM=0) is Lean-certified; there is no certified necessary direction and no certified lower bound tying RM to the EXACT canonical term in the nonlinear/quantum cases.

Backreaction instantiation is a 1-variable Jensen toy, not Buchert's tensorial Q_D; the match to the real cosmological backreaction term is qualitative (sign/growth), so the 'same term' claim is weakest in domain (b).
No stochastic-lens / continuum backbone in the certified core (Lean covers deterministic partition lenses only), so the LES filtering and ensemble-average lenses sit outside the mechanized layer.
proof_route.fallback_result: If the genuine-unification object cannot be built, the defensible deliverable is the minimum-viable note presented strictly as a UNIFYING DIAGNOSTIC/taxonomy: one portable scalar RM>0 with one shared vanishing criterion (linear or factorizing or record-diagonal => RM=0) that detects 'a correction term has been omitted by this coarse-graining' across all three domains, validated by recovering each domain's already-known term — a methodological contribution (a cross-domain audit), not a physical unification.

card.baseline_comparison: SBT RECOVERS and REORGANIZES; it does not outperform the standard accounts. Each correction term (LES subgrid stress, Buchert backreaction, measurement-evolution incompatibility) is the canonical result in its field, imported wholesale and relabeled as a route-mismatch residual. The genuine value-add is a SHARED vanishing criterion (factorization / linearity / record-diagonality => RM=0) plus a portable scalar diagnostic — i.e. a cross-domain audit/taxonomy. Versus the standard per-domain treatment: SBT does NOT predict any term's magnitude better, does NOT derive any underlying theory (explicitly disclaims Navier-Stokes, GR, Born rule), and only the trivial sufficient commutation direction is Lean-certified. So it is strictly a reframing/compression win, weaker than each domain's own machinery on physical content, but stronger on cross-domain portability of the 'omitted-effective-term' diagnostic.
card.why_scientists_care: If credible, it gives one auditable, computable scalar (RM>0) and one falsifiable vanishing law that flags 'your coarse-grained model is missing an effective term' uniformly across turbulence closure, cosmological averaging, and quantum measurement — turning three separately-discovered 'a correction appears under coarse-graining' phenomena into instances of a single, mechanically-checkable noncommutation pattern (nonlinearity or non-diagonality + information-losing lens). Even as 'only' a reorganization, a clean common template with a Lean-certified sufficient condition and a sharp null is a useful pedagogical and diagnostic unifier, and pinpoints exactly where genuine cross-domain unification would have to be earned (a common ambient algebra).
target_audience: Multiscale modeling / model-reduction and LES turbulence-closure researchers
Cosmologists working on averaging and backreaction (Buchert/Rasanen/Wiltshire programme)
Quantum foundations / decoherence and measurement-theory researchers
Applied-math / category-and-operator-theory audiences interested in coarse-graining as a noncommutation problem
Formal-methods / Lean community interested in mechanized structural lemmas for physics
card.recommended_artifact: A short cross-domain note (5-8 pp) plus one deterministic reproducible script: Section 1 states the route-mismatch template and the single certified lemma (factorization => RM=0); Sections 2-4 re-derive tau_sgs, the Jensen/backreaction gap, and the [Delta,U] defect as residuals of the one functional, each with its existing null-vs-active sweep; one combined figure showing the shared 'RM=0 on control, monotone off control' signature; an explicit Limitations box honoring the four relevant disclaimers (no NS/GR/Born derivation, cosmological constant not ruled out) and stating clearly that this is structural reorganization, with the genuine-unification (common ambient object) flagged as the open hard step.
card.execution_cost: Low for the minimum-viable result: the three instantiations and their null-vs-active tables already exist as deterministic Python suites and the one sufficient-direction lemma is already Lean-certified; the work is assembling them under one template and writing the honest unification statement (days, not weeks). High-to-research-grade for the stronger result: building a genuine common ambient algebra/operad in which the three terms are literally one construction is an open theoretical problem with no existing scaffold in the corpus.
card.honest_status_note: This is the strongest genuine cross-domain claim in the corpus but it is REFRAMING, not prediction. Every domain's correction term (LES subgrid stress, Buchert backreaction, measurement-evolution incompatibility) was independently established and is imported wholesale; SBT supplies only the closure/audit layer. The 'same object' claim is, as the papers themselves treat it, structural analogy at the level of 'a commutator of a projection with a flow' — the physical content (turbulent cascade vs cosmic acceleration vs Born-rule statistics) is explicitly NOT unified, and the corpus disclaims deriving Navier-Stokes, GR backreaction, and the Born rule, and does not rule out a cosmological constant. Only the trivial sufficient direction (factorization => commutation, RM=0) is Lean-certified; there is no certified lower bound tying RM to the exact canonical term, and the backreaction instantiation is a scalar Jensen toy, not tensorial Buchert. The genuine-unification lemma (a single ambient construction) is NOT in the papers and is the load-bearing gap; without it the defensible deliverable is a unifying diagnostic/taxonomy, not a physical unification. Derivability class B (computational/structural demonstration), bordering C on the unification claim itself.

adhoc_test_answers.question: Was the target fact known before the theory component was built (i.e., is this a retrodiction reverse-engineered to hit a known answer)?
adhoc_test_answers.answer: Yes, entirely. All three facts predate SBT and are imported wholesale: tau_sgs (Leonard 1974, Germano 1992), Buchert backreaction / Jensen effect, and unitary-dephasing noncommutation ([Delta,U]=0 iff H block-diagonal in the record basis). The card's own honest_status_note says 'Every domain's correction term... was independently established and is imported wholesale; SBT supplies only the closure/audit layer.' The template was chosen to reproduce these, not to predict them.

adhoc_test_answers.question: Does the mechanism import known physics rather than deriving it?
adhoc_test_answers.answer: Yes. The dynamics (Burgers RK4 flux, nonlinear ODE flow, unitary conjugation + Lueders pinching) are imported in full; SBT contributes only the relabeling 'commutator of a coarse-graining projection with a flow = route mismatch'. The papers explicitly disclaim deriving Navier-Stokes, GR backreaction, and the Born rule (To_Become_a_Stone; Quantum; Dark Energy), and the ledger's hidden_physics_dependence lists LES/Germano-Leonard, Buchert averaging, and Lueders pinching as imported.

adhoc_test_answers.question: How many independent data points are actually matched, and how many tunable knobs were used to match them?
adhoc_test_answers.answer: 3 qualitative structural facts matched (LES subgrid term, Jensen/backreaction gap, [Delta,U] defect) against ~10 adjustable knobs (lens, completion, tau, metric, activation knob and its null value per domain, rewrite ansatz A/m, seed, residual-naming, toy-dynamics selection). Degrees of freedom vastly exceed matched facts. The match is structural (RM=0 on control, RM>0 off control) not quantitative: SBT does not predict any term's magnitude better than the standard account (baseline_comparison: 'does NOT predict any term's magnitude better').

adhoc_test_answers.question: Is the only certified claim trivial relative to the headline?
adhoc_test_answers.answer: Yes. The single Lean-certified result is commutes_of_factorsThrough / routeMismatch_of_commute: factorization-through-the-macro-layer implies commutation implies RM=0. This is the trivial sufficient direction only. There is NO certified necessary direction, NO certified lower bound tying RM to the exact canonical term, and the headline cross-domain unification lemma (a single map whose specializations ARE tau_sgs, Q_D, [Delta,U]) is explicitly NOT proved (already_in_papers=false; difficulty hard/research-grade).

adhoc_test_answers.question: Could the same template fit the opposite or a different observation equally well?
adhoc_test_answers.answer: Yes (see opposite-world test). RM is a sign-free magnitude >=0 with a freely chosen metric; it flags 'a term is missing' but cannot predict the term's sign, magnitude, or tensor structure. A different acceleration sign, a different subgrid-stress form, or any nonzero residual would be 'recovered' identically as 'RM>0 off control'. Only the vanishing criterion (linear/factorizing/record-diagonal => RM=0) is sharp, and that is the trivial Lean direction.

adhoc_test_answers.question: Is the cross-domain 'unification' a genuine single construction or a structural analogy?
adhoc_test_answers.answer: Analogy. The card, the ledger structural law, and the papers all state the unification is at the level of 'a commutator of a projection with a flow'. The genuine common ambient object (one morphism class for filtering/averaging/dephasing, one endofunctor class for Burgers/FLRW/unitary) is the named, unbuilt, load-bearing gap. Without it this is structural parallelism / a portable diagnostic, not a physical unification. The card itself rates derivability class B 'bordering C on the unification claim'.

adhoc_test_answers.question: Does the backreaction instantiation actually recover the cosmological term, or a weaker proxy?
adhoc_test_answers.answer: A weaker proxy. It is a scalar 1-variable Jensen toy (y'=y^2, s=0 control ~3.89e-16), explicitly NOT a GR computation and NOT Buchert's tensorial kinematical backreaction Q_D. The match is qualitative (sign/growth-with-variance) only. This is the weakest of the three domains for the 'same term' claim, per the card's estimated_bottlenecks. Verified: Dark Energy paper line 523 states 'it is not the GR-averaging kinematical backreaction term, and we do not claim Toy 2 constitutes a relativistic backreaction calculation.'

adhoc_test_answers.question: Are the disclaimers honored, and does honoring them void the strong claim?
adhoc_test_answers.answer: Disclaimers are honored (no Born rule, no continuum/NS/GR derivation, Lambda not ruled out, pointer-basis selection undetermined, P3/RM explicitly not a directionality certificate). Honoring them confines the deliverable to reorganization/diagnostic: the cosmology piece is synthetic only (Omega_Lambda~0.60 from a null-Lambda generator) with m saturating at ~0 on real data (degenerate with Lambda), so it discriminates nothing empirically. The honest claim is a cross-domain audit/taxonomy, not new physics or a prediction.

opposite_world_test.explanation: RM is a non-negative, sign-free scalar under a freely chosen metric d. Its only sharp, certified content is the vanishing criterion (linear / factorizing / record-diagonal => RM=0), which is the trivial Lean direction. Off the control axis ANY nonzero residual is labeled 'RM>0, a term is omitted' regardless of its sign, magnitude, or structure. (a) Opposite acceleration: a heterogeneous generator producing apparent DECELERATION (or no acceleration) would still give RM>0 and would be fit by a different sign/shape of Delta_H=A(1+z)^{-m}; the fitted Omega_Lambda~0.60 is a synthetic artifact, and on real data m saturates at ~0, degenerate with Lambda, so the framework discriminates neither sign nor existence of acceleration. (b) Fake arrow: route mismatch is EXPLICITLY not a directionality certificate (Foundations I; protocol trap), so SBT cannot and does not claim RM=0 vs RM>0 maps to any arrow direction; it would 'explain' either equally. (c) Non-diagonal pointer basis: pointer-basis selection is disclaimed; for ANY chosen record basis, RM=0 iff H is diagonal in it and RM>0 otherwise — so a world where the 'natural' pointer basis were different is accommodated by simply re-choosing the lens, with the 0.350099-vs-0 separation reappearing under the new choice. In every case the template reproduces the observation because the observation is imported as the dynamics and only the trivial commute=>RM=0 statement is load-bearing. The framework is therefore not risky: it would 'retrodict' the opposite world with equal ease.

audit.audit_verdict: HIGH FLEXIBILITY / REFRAMING, NOT PREDICTION. R027 reuses one core mechanism (route-mismatch, RM_d(E,T;rho)=d(E T rho, T E rho)) across >=2 facts — in fact all three target facts plus the dark-energy-as-rewrite instance — so the mechanism_tag 'route-mismatch' genuinely recurs, which is a point in its favor for parsimony. BUT the degrees of freedom (~10 adjustable choices: lens, completion, tau, metric, per-domain activation knob and null value, fitted rewrite shape A/m, seed, residual-naming, toy-dynamics selection) vastly exceed the 3 structural facts matched, and the facts were all known and imported wholesale before the template was applied (target_used_to_design_theory=true; imports_known_physics=true). Only the trivial sufficient direction (FactorsThrough => commutation => RM=0; Lean commutes_of_factorsThrough / routeMismatch_of_commute) is certified; the headline cross-domain unification lemma (a single construction whose specializations ARE tau_sgs, Buchert Q_D, and [Delta,U]) is explicitly NOT in the papers and is research-grade. RM is a sign-free magnitude under a chosen metric, so the opposite-world test passes trivially: opposite acceleration sign, a fake arrow, or a different pointer basis would all be 'recovered' as RM>0-off-control with no penalty. The backreaction instantiation is a scalar Jensen toy, not tensorial Buchert, so domain (b)'s 'same term' claim is decorative. The defensible reading — consistent with every honored disclaimer (no Born rule, no NS/GR/continuum derivation, Lambda not ruled out, pointer-basis undetermined, RM not a directionality certificate) — is a unifying DIAGNOSTIC/taxonomy: one portable scalar with one shared (trivial) vanishing criterion that flags 'a coarse-graining omitted a term', validated by recovering three already-known terms. As a physical unification or a retrodiction it is overfit and unfalsifiable; as cross-domain bookkeeping it is honest reorganization. Overfitting risk: HIGH for the unification claim, LOW for the narrow certified vanishing lemma.

skeptic_panel.consensus: All four skeptics agree the headline 'unification' is unearned (is_actually_new=false, beats_baseline=false for all four). The load-bearing common ambient object (one morphism class for filtering/averaging/dephasing, one endofunctor class for Burgers/FLRW/unitary) is verified absent from the corpus. The only certified content is the trivial sufficient direction (FactorsThrough => RM=0) over a uniform-on-fibers toy lens, and the To_Become_a_Stone paper states verbatim (line 265) that 'none of our physics instantiations assumes exact factorization' — so the certified lemma is logically disjoint from all three instantiations. All four converge on the SAME repair: downgrade from 'unification' to 'cross-domain unifying diagnostic/taxonomy', which is the card's own fallback_result. The ledger structural-laws entry (line 186) already names this cross-domain grouping as the intended frozen reading, so the unification claim is also a novelty failure (it restates an intended reading already in the corpus).

members.skeptic_role: Observational cosmologist focused on model degeneracies, held-out prediction, and model comparison; here assessing a cross-domain 'unification' claim that touches cosmological backreaction/dark energy.
members.main_objection: The headline word 'unification' is unearned. What is actually delivered is structural ANALOGY plus relabeling: three independently established, imported correction terms (LES subgrid stress, a scalar Jensen backreaction proxy, the unitary-vs-dephasing commutator) are each re-described as 'the leading residual of one commutator functional.' The single load-bearing object that would make this a unification — a common ambient algebra/operad/category in which filtering, spatial averaging, and dephasing are literally one morphism class and Burgers flux, FLRW averaging, and unitary conjugation are literally one endofunctor class — does not exist in the corpus (verified: no operad/monoidal/natural-transformation machinery anywhere in the two main papers), and the card itself flags it research-grade and absent. Stripped of that object, R027 is a portable diagnostic/taxonomy, not a physical or even mathematical unification.

members.skeptic_role: Mathematical physicist specializing in coarse-graining/closure (LES, Mori-Zwanzig, renormalization) cross-checked against cosmological averaging (Buchert) and quantum measurement theory; adversarial on operator-algebraic unification claims.
members.main_objection: The headline 'single finite operator identity ... is the common structural template whose leading correction term instantiates exactly as tau_sgs, the Buchert/Jensen term, and the [Delta,U] defect' overstates what is established. The only certified content is the TRIVIAL sufficient direction (commutes_of_factorsThrough / routeMismatch_of_commute), confirmed verbatim in To_Become_a_Stone (lines 256-265) and Dark Energy. There is NO theorem deriving any of the three correction terms from a common object; the papers themselves call this 'instantiations of the same operator template' using THREE DIFFERENT metrics d. The word 'exactly' is licensed only for the LES algebraic identity tau_sgs = overline(u^2)-(bar u)^2, which is the standard Leonard/Germano result imported wholesale.
fatal_objections: No fatal objection in the sense of internal contradiction or disclaimer violation: the card honors every relevant SBT disclaimer and never claims to derive the dynamics. Treated strictly as the fallback deliverable (a cross-domain diagnostic/taxonomy), nothing is fatally broken. The headline 'unification' claim is unsupported but the card flags this itself, so it is a downgrade-to-reframing issue, not a fatal falsehood.

members.skeptic_role: Effective-field-theory / known-physics-recovery skeptic: is this anything more than three textbook coarse-graining-vs-evolution commutators relabeled 'route mismatch' and stapled together under a shared name?
members.main_objection: Nothing is derived and nothing is unified. All three 'recovered' terms are standard results imported wholesale (the frozen ledger's own hidden_physics_dependence line literally says turbulence modeling is 'imported wholesale; SBT relabels the filter-advection commutator as route mismatch', and the dark-energy paper states the Q-term 'is not the GR-averaging kinematical backreaction term'). The single Lean-certified result is the trivial sufficient direction and — by the paper's own admission ('none of our physics instantiations assumes exact factorization') — does NOT apply to any of the three instantiations it is advertised to underwrite. So the certified content is logically disjoint from the headline, and the headline cross-domain unification lemma is explicitly absent. What remains is a name plus a per-domain non-negative scalar, i.e. relabeling, not new structure.
fatal_objections: The headline 'unification' is a single common ambient object and it does NOT exist in the corpus: the card itself marks it already_in_papers=false, difficulty research-grade, and the papers only ever say 'mirrors' / 'portable across domains' / 'the same template', i.e. structural analogy. The strong claim is asserted, never constructed.

The only certified lemma (commutes_of_factorsThrough / routeMismatch_of_commute) is the trivial sufficient direction and is, per To_Become_a_Stone, NOT assumed by any of the three physics instantiations. There is no certified necessary direction and no certified lower bound tying RM to the exact canonical term. The certified result therefore does not support the headline at all.

members.skeptic_role: A multiscale-modeling / applied-operator-theory specialist who also works on cosmological backreaction and quantum decoherence, reviewing a cross-domain 'unification' claim for novelty and rigor.
members.main_objection: The headline is an analogy dressed as a unification, and even that analogy is NOT new: the frozen ledger's own structural-laws entry already states verbatim that route mismatch 'is the universal mechanism behind subgrid stress (LES), backreaction (Jensen), contextuality, and dark-energy-as-rewrite.' The card therefore re-asserts the intended frozen reading and adds nothing the corpus does not already claim. The only thing that would upgrade analogy to unification (a common ambient algebra/operad) is explicitly absent. What survives is a portable diagnostic scalar RM>=0 plus one trivial Lean-certified sufficient lemma, validated by recovering three results that were all known and imported wholesale.
fatal_objections: The strong claim that the three correction terms are 'literally one construction' / 'the same object' is unsupported: the only common object is the schematic functional form RM_d(E,T;rho)=d(ETrho,TErho), which is just 'a metric on a commutator of a projection-like map with a flow.' As a UNIFICATION the result is not derived, only asserted; it is fatal to the unification reading (though not to the weaker diagnostic reading).

Novelty failure: the cross-domain reading is already the explicit frozen-ledger structural law (ledger.json structural_laws_relevant_to_physics). R027 is a restatement of an intended reading already in the corpus, not a new result. is_actually_new fails for the unification claim.

Confine the 'exact term' claim to the LES leg only (where tau_sgs = overline(u^2)-(bar u)^2 is a genuine algebraic identity); downgrade the quantum and backreaction legs to 'RM detects the known correction's regime / structurally parallel', not 'the same exact term'.

Explicit statement that the single Lean-certified result is the trivial sufficient direction over a uniform-on-fibers toy lens and does NOT formalize the LES, backreaction, or quantum instances ('none of our physics instantiations assumes exact factorization').

Explicit labeling that all three dynamics and all three correction terms are imported wholesale and pre-date SBT (recovery, not derivation), and that no term's magnitude is predicted better than its native account.
Cosmology instance flagged as a scalar Jensen proxy, NOT Buchert tensorial Q_D, and as empirically degenerate with Lambda (m~0) on public data.

All relevant disclaimers honored in a Limitations box (no NS/GR/Born derivation; Lambda not ruled out; pointer-basis selection undetermined; P3/RM not a directionality certificate); RM stated to be a sign-free magnitude that predicts no term's sign, magnitude, or tensor structure.
Genuine-unification (common ambient object) flagged as an UNSOLVED open problem, with the (b)-domain Jensen-vs-Buchert gap and the per-domain-metric incommensurability named as the obstructions.
skeptic_panel.what_would_change_their_mind_union: Construct the genuine common ambient object (a noncommutative algebra / monoidal category / operad of coarse-grainings) in which filtering, spatial averaging and dephasing are provably ONE morphism class and Burgers flux, FLRW dust averaging and unitary conjugation are provably ONE endofunctor class, with tau_sgs, Buchert's tensorial Q_D (not a scalar Jensen toy), and [Delta,U] recovered as corollaries of a SINGLE natural-transformation defect under a single metric; ideally with a certified NECESSARY direction (RM=0 => factorization) and a lower bound tying RM to the exact canonical term in the nonlinear AND quantum cases. Failing the full object, a held-out empirical discriminator where the RM diagnostic predicts a correction term's sign or magnitude that the standard per-domain account does not would also move them.

repair.repair_philosophy: Applied only allowed repairs: (1) narrow/split the overbroad headline 'unification' into a defensible 'cross-domain unifying diagnostic/taxonomy' (the card's own fallback, also the unanimous skeptic minimum-acceptance condition); (2) replace 'instantiates exactly' with leg-specific precision — EXACT only for the LES algebraic identity, APPROXIMATE/structurally-parallel for the quantum leg, QUALITATIVE-PROXY for the backreaction leg; (3) convert the rhetorical 'same object' into an explicit lemma sequence with the genuine-unification lemma flagged as an unproven open obligation; (4) clarify the mapping by foregrounding that the one Lean-certified lemma is the trivial sufficient direction over a uniform-on-fibers toy lens and is logically disjoint from all three physics instantiations (verified verbatim, To_Become_a_Stone line 265). No forbidden moves: no new assumptions added, no hidden tuning, imported physics is foregrounded not hidden, no unproven uniqueness asserted, no 'naturally emerges'. The claim survives as a methodological diagnostic; it does NOT survive as a physical or mathematical unification.

score_rationale.impact: 2/5. As a physical unification it would be high-impact, but that reading is dead (no common ambient object; the grouping is already the intended ledger reading). As a cross-domain diagnostic/taxonomy it is a modest pedagogical/methodological contribution: one portable scalar + one vanishing law that flags an omitted effective term. Useful as a teaching/audit unifier, but it derives nothing, predicts nothing, and beats no per-domain machinery, so real scientific impact is limited.
score_rationale.execution_ease: 5/5. The three instantiations and their null-vs-active sweeps already exist as deterministic Python suites; the one sufficient-direction lemma is already Lean-certified; the LES identity is textbook. The minimum-viable note is days of assembly + honest writing, not weeks. Lowest-cost item in its class.
score_rationale.plausibility: 4/5. The structural claim that all three corrections are 'a commutator of a coarse-graining projection with a flow' is true and uncontroversial; the LES identity is exact; the dephasing fixed-point characterization is elementary and Lean-certified. Capped below 5 only because the strongest wording ('same object') is not plausible without the unbuilt ambient object.
score_rationale.non_ad_hocness: 2/5. The mechanism (route-mismatch) genuinely recurs across all three facts plus dark-energy, which is parsimony in its favor. But ~10 adjustable choices (per-domain lens/completion/metric/activation-knob/null-value, fitted A/m, seed, residual-naming, toy-dynamics selection) vastly exceed 3 facts matched; each domain's 'canonical term' is picked post hoc to hit a known answer; the backreaction leg substitutes a scalar toy for the real tensorial term. The certified lemma is disjoint from the instances. Net: structurally motivated core, heavily ad hoc in instantiation.
score_rationale.discriminative_power: 1/5. RM is a sign-free non-negative magnitude under a freely chosen per-domain metric; its only sharp content is the trivial vanishing criterion. The opposite-world test passes against it (opposite acceleration, fake arrow, different pointer basis all 'recovered' as RM>0-off-control). It predicts no sign, magnitude, or tensor structure and discriminates nothing empirically (cosmology degenerate with Lambda at m~0). Near-zero discriminative power.
score_rationale.audience_legibility: 4/5. The route-mismatch commutator, the LES subgrid-stress identity, dephasing fixed points, and a Lean-certified sufficient lemma are all clean, legible, and directly checkable for multiscale-modeling, quantum-foundations, and formal-methods audiences. Slightly capped because the cross-domain 'same' framing risks over-reading and the per-domain metric incommensurability needs careful explanation.
score_rationale.precision: 2/5. Precise and exact ONLY in the LES leg (algebraic identity). The quantum leg is asserted-plus-numerically-swept (RM=0 iff diagonal H is not itself a certified theorem), and the backreaction leg is a qualitative scalar proxy with a suppressed sign. SBT disclaimers (no NS/GR/Born derivation, RM not a directionality certificate) cap precision: the framework cannot make a sharp quantitative claim about two of the three legs.
score_rationale.robustness: 3/5. The deterministic sweeps are reproducible (seed 0, robustness seeds 0-9), the controls (sigma=0, s=0, diagonal H) reliably give ~0, and the LES identity is robust. But the 0.350099 figure is seed-specific, the per-domain metric choices are not forced, and the central interpretive premise ('same kind of object') is not robust to the demand for a single construction. Moderate.
score_rationale.baseline_advantage: 1/5. The card's own baseline_comparison concedes SBT 'does NOT predict any term's magnitude better' and 'does NOT derive any underlying theory.' Each domain's native machinery (Germano/Leonard, Buchert, decoherence theory) is strictly more informative on physical content. The only edge is cross-domain portability of a relabeling, which is not a predictive/explanatory advantage. SBT disclaimers cap this hard.
score_rationale.publication_potential: 2/5. Not publishable as a 'unification' (novelty fails — it is the intended ledger reading — and the load-bearing object is absent). Publishable as an honest short methods/pedagogy note or workshop contribution on cross-domain coarse-graining diagnostics with mechanized lemmas, for an applied-math / formal-methods venue. Modest.

recommended_artifact: A short (5-8 pp) cross-domain methods note, retitled as a UNIFYING DIAGNOSTIC / TAXONOMY (not a unification): Section 1 states RM and the single Lean-certified sufficient lemma (factorization => RM=0), explicitly flagging it as a uniform-on-fibers toy lens that formalizes none of the three physics instances; Sections 2-4 recover tau_sgs (exact algebraic identity), the [Delta,U] defect (structurally parallel), and a scalar Jensen proxy for backreaction (explicitly not Buchert Q_D), each with its existing null-vs-active sweep on separate RM axes; one combined figure showing the shared 'RM=0 on control, monotone off control' signature; a Limitations box honoring all relevant disclaimers (no NS/GR/Born derivation, Lambda not ruled out, pointer-basis undetermined, RM not a directionality certificate, RM sign-free) and naming the common-ambient-object as the open hard step. Pair with the existing deterministic reproducible script. Do NOT invest in the stronger result unless a serious attempt at the common ambient algebra/operad is independently motivated.
one_line_verdict: An honest, low-cost cross-domain DIAGNOSTIC that recovers three known correction terms under one sign-free scalar with a trivial Lean-certified vanishing law — but it is reorganization/taxonomy (already the intended ledger reading), not a unification, not new, and beats no per-domain baseline; survives only as a reframing (bin E, low priority).
